BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to promoting prostitution; amending RCW 9A.88.070;and prescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 9A.88.070 and 2007 c 368 s 13 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A person is guilty of promoting prostitution in the firstdegree if he or she knowingly advances prostitution: (a) By compelling a person by threat or force to engage inprostitution or profits from prostitution which results from suchthreat or force; or (b) By compelling a person with a mental or developmentaldisability, that renders the person incapable of consent, to engage inprostitution or profits from prostitution. (2) Promoting prostitution in the first degree is a class B felony.
